# TEST ORACLE ONLY — never read by product code.
# The AD104 (RTX 4070) display capabilities page, every non-zero word `<byte offset> <value>`, as a stock
# Windows 580.88 driver read it on bare metal (VFIO DVI reference boot3, 8-byte reads 10.948826-10.953350 s,
# 2026-10-08; record `traces/display_reply_diff_20261008/`, row P16r). Class NVC773_DISP_CAPABILITIES, page
# NV_PDISP_FE_SW at BAR0 0x640000. It was the captured table behind `KF3_DISPLAY_CAPS_PROBE` (removed
# 2026-10-14, docs/design/V3_DISPLAY_CAPS_DERIVATION_20261014.md). The derived page is held to it field by
# field in `tests/caps_derive.rs`; nothing here is served to a guest.
